Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Anirudh Deshpande. I am a 40-year-old shopkeeper living in Thane. My employer Pai Pharma Ltd owes me INR 3,10,000/- after firing me, and the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 70979 33769 or email anirudh.deshpande@example.com.
